verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a programmatic `mcpClient.tools()` call that 'automatically loads all available tools' for a connected app, and the live endpoint probe confirms the MCP server responds to JSON-RPC requests, showing some machine-readable tool discovery. However, there is no documented registry/catalog API for browsing the full list of 3,000+ integrated apps/servers before connecting — discovery is scoped per-user/per-app rather than a global catalog query. Missing for 10: a documented catalog/registry-listing endpoint (not just per-connection tools()), independent confirmation of full catalog enumeration.
